name: Safeguard
text: [reaction] During another investigator's turn, exhaust Safeguard: For the remainder of that investigator's turn, as they move from your location to a connecting location, you may move to that location as well.
text_cn: [reaction]在另一位调查员的回合中，消耗安全护卫：该调查员的回合接下来的时间里，其从你所在地点移动到连接地点时，你也可以移动到该地点。
